title: Folding Attention Biases into Keys Makes Compacted KV Caches Run on Standard Kernels
abstract: arXiv:2610.36520v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Attention Matching (AM) compacts a KV cache by keeping some keys per head, refitting their values and adding a bias to each kept key's logit. FlashAttention and vLLM's paged caches have no input for it. We fold the bias into the keys along one closed-form direction per head, fitted on context queries, giving a plain cache with AM's size and head dimension and the model's own query path; the output error is bounded by how far each query's projection on that direction is from 1. With equal per-head budgets, unmodified vLLM serves folded caches through a KV connector, matching Hugging Face's answers on all 51 Qwen3-4B questions and its greedy output on 180 of 200 Qwen3-14B LongBench samples. With equal budgets on QuALITY (Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, 8B, Llama-3.1-8B) and LongHealth (three Qwen3 models), the fold is within noise of AM's accuracy in 13 of 14 settings, with lower KL to the full cache than dropping the bias in all 12 where both ran. translated_title: 将注意力偏置折叠进键向量使压缩的KV缓存能在标准内核上运行
translated_abstract: 注意力匹配（AM）通过在每个注意力头保留部分键、重新拟合其值并为每个保留键的logit添加偏置来压缩KV缓存，但FlashAttention和vLLM的分页缓存没有针对该偏置的输入接口。本文将偏置沿每个注意力头一个基于上下文查询拟合的闭式解方向折叠进键中，从而得到一个具有AM的大小和头维度以及模型自身查询路径的普通缓存；输出误差由每个查询在该方向上的投影偏离1的程度所界定。在相同的每头预算下，未经修改的vLLM通过KV连接器即可服务折叠后的缓存，在所有51个Qwen3-4B问题上与Hugging Face的答案完全一致，并在200个Qwen3-14B LongBench样本中的180个上与其贪心输出一致。在QuALITY（Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B、Llama-3.1-8B）和LongHealth（三个Qwen3模型）上使用相同预算时，折叠方法在14个设置中的13个与AM的精度差异在噪声范围内，并且在两者均可运行的12个设置中，其与完整缓存的KL散度均低于直接丢弃偏置的做法。
tldr: 该论文提出一种闭式折叠方法，将注意力匹配压缩KV缓存时引入的logit偏置直接折叠进键向量本身，使压缩后的缓存无需修改即可在FlashAttention和vLLM等标准注意力内核上运行，且精度与原始AM方法基本相当。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a closed-form folding method that absorbs Attention Matching's logit biases into the key vectors of compacted KV caches, enabling them to run unmodified on standard kernels like FlashAttention and vLLM while essentially preserving AM's accuracy.
